# Anshkosh

> Anshkosh is a public validation platform for Indian startups before launch.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.anshkosh.com/): Overview of the public validation platform.
- [Discover startups](https://www.anshkosh.com/discover): Browse startup profiles and evidence as the pilot opens.
- [Categories](https://www.anshkosh.com/categories): Explore startups by industry category.
- [Journal](https://www.anshkosh.com/journal): Founder stories, startup insights, and validation guidance.
- [FAQ](https://www.anshkosh.com/faq): Questions about validation, campaigns, and participation.
- [Trust & Safety](https://www.anshkosh.com/trust-safety): Platform standards and accountability practices.
- [Contact](https://www.anshkosh.com/contact): Contact the Anshkosh team.
- [Free founder toolkit and launch support](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support): Free founder tools with browser-saved drafts and downloadable results, alongside startup listings and support requests. Automated directory submissions and backlink packages are not currently available.
- [Directory catalogue](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/directories): Source-backed starter list with audience, eligibility and cost notes. External fees may apply.
- [Launch checklist](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/checklist): Free preparation checklist; progress is saved only in the visitor's browser.
- [Launch kit](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/kit): Free editable launch-copy template with browser-saved drafts and shared startup details. Owners can prefill from their saved startup through the authenticated dashboard and explicitly reuse those details in the free toolkit. No automated submissions.
- [Customer validation planner](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/validation): Plan interviews, record observations and next experiments, and download an evidence worksheet. No account required.
- [MVP Scope Cutter](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/mvp): Categorise planned features using the founder's own answers and download a first-build plan.
- [Startup pitch builder](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/pitch): Create a pitch, introduction and announcement using the founder's own words. No invented traction or AI service required.
- [Launch card maker](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/launch-card): Create landscape or square PNG graphics with an optional local logo. Logo files are not uploaded; downloads have no watermark.
- [Runway calculator](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/runway): Estimate cash runway in rupees under constant monthly expense and revenue assumptions. Includes expense scenarios and a 12-month cash table.
- [Directory submission tracker](https://www.anshkosh.com/launch-support/tracker): Manually track submissions, published listing URLs and follow-up dates. CSV export is free; no automatic submissions or reminders.

## Editorial and product context

Anshkosh is currently an early-access pilot. Public validation, applications, accounts, and interest lists may be available, but backing payments and reward orders are not currently open. Validation signals are not investments, securities, orders, revenue, or guarantees of delivery.
